method.name: Baseline
method.note: Flags mean unusual for this address's own history, nothing more.

limitationLine: Worth investigating, not proof of wrongdoing.

features.name: Size
features.description: How much the address received or sent in this transaction (BTC).

features.name: Burst
features.description: How many earlier transactions the address made in the previous 7 days.

features.name: Gap
features.description: Hours since the address's previous transaction.

features.name: Relative size
features.description: This amount divided by the address's usual amount in the same direction.
